POWERSHELL SHENANIGANS LATERAL MOVEMENT WITH POWERSHELL KIERAN JACOBSEN HP ENTERPRISE SERVICES 2. ABOUT:ME \xe2\x80\xa2 Kieran Jacobsen \xe2\x80\xa2 HP Enterprise Services \xe2\x80\x93 Engineer/Architect \xe2\x80\xa2 Microsoft/Automation/Security focus \xe2\x80\xa2 Twitter: @Kjacobsen \xe2\x80\xa2 Blog: Aperturescience.su 3. OUTLINE \xe2\x80\xa2 PowerShell as an attack platform \xe2\x80\xa2 PowerShell malware \xe2\x80\xa2 PowerShell Remoting & WinRM \xe2\x80\xa2 PowerShell security, and bypassing that security \xe2\x80\xa2 Defence 4. CHALLENGE \xe2\x80\xa2 Move from social engineered workstation to domain controller \xe2\x80\xa2 Where possible use only PowerShell code \xe2\x80\xa2 Demo environment will be a \xe2\x80\x9ccorporate like\xe2\x80\x9d environment 5. ADVANTAGES AS AN ATTACK PLATFORM \xe2\x80\xa2 Code is very easy to develop \xe2\x80\xa2 Windows integration \xe2\x80\xa2 Plenty of remote execution options \xe2\x80\xa2 Designed for automation against 1 \xe2\x80\x93 10000000 devices \xe2\x80\xa2 Limited security model \xe2\x80\xa2 Antivirus products are no real concern/limitation \xe2\x80\xa2 Scripts can be easily hidden from administrators \xe2\x80\xa2 Installed by DEFAULT 6. REAL WORLD POWERSHELL MALWARE \xe2\x80\xa2 Prior to March 2014, only a few minor instances \xe2\x80\xa2 PowerWorm: \xe2\x80\xa2 Infect\xe2\x80\x99s Word and Excel documents, initial infection via macro in .doc/.xls \xe2\x80\xa2 First spotted by TrendMicro, analysis and rewrite by Matt Graeber (@Mattifestation) \xe2\x80\xa2 PoshKoder/PoshCoder: \xe2\x80\xa2 PowerWorm crossed with CryptoLocker \xe2\x80\xa2 Bitcoin ransom 7. MY POWERSHELL MALWARE \xe2\x80\xa2 Single Script \xe2\x80\x93 SystemInformation.ps1 \xe2\x80\xa2 Runs as a schedule task, every 5 minutes \xe2\x80\xa2 Script: \xe2\x80\xa2 Collects system information and more \xe2\x80\xa2 Connects to C2 infrastructure, downloads a task list and executes tasks \xe2\x80\xa2 Executes each task, if successful, task will not be rerun \xe2\x80\xa2 Tasks can be restricted to individual computers 8. DEMO: THE ENTRY 9. WINDOWS POWERSHELL REMOTING AND WINRM \xe2\x80\xa2 PowerShell Remoting is based upon WinRM, Microsoft\xe2\x80\x99s WS-Management implementation \xe2\x80\xa2 Supports execution in 3 ways: \xe2\x80\xa2 Remote enabled commands \xe2\x80\xa2 Remotely executed script blocks \xe2\x80\xa2 Remote sessions \xe2\x80\xa2 Security Model = Trusted Devices + User Credentials \xe2\x80\xa2 WinRM is required for the Windows Server Manager \xe2\x80\xa2 WinRM is enabled by DEFAULT on Windows 2012(R2) Server \xe2\x80\xa2 WinRM is allowed through Windows Firewall on all network profiles! 10. DEMO: THE DC 11. POWERSHELL SECURITY FEATURES \xe2\x80\xa2 Administrative rights \xe2\x80\xa2 UAC \xe2\x80\xa2 Code Signing \xe2\x80\xa2 Local or Remote source using zone.identifier alternate data stream \xe2\x80\xa2 PowerShell Execution Policy 12. EXECUTION POLICY There are 6 states for the execution policy \xe2\x80\xa2 Unrestricted All scripts can run \xe2\x80\xa2 Remote Signed No unsigned scripts from the Internet can run \xe2\x80\xa2 All Signed No unsigned scripts can run \xe2\x80\xa2 Restricted No scripts are allowed to run \xe2\x80\xa2 Undefined (Default) If no policy defined, then default to restricted \xe2\x80\xa2 Bypass Policy processor is bypassed 13. BYPASSING EXECUTION POLICY \xe2\x80\xa2 Simply ask PowerShell: powershell.exe \xe2\x80\x93executionpolicy unrestricted \xe2\x80\xa2 Switch the files zone.idenfier back to local: unblock- file yourscript.ps1 \xe2\x80\xa2 Read the script in and then execute it (may fail depending on script) \xe2\x80\xa2 Encode the script and use \xe2\x80\x93encodedcommand \xef\x83 always works!!!!! \xe2\x80\xa2 Get/Steal a certificate, sign script, run script 14. DEMO: THE HASHES 15. DEFENCE OF THE DARK ARTS \xe2\x80\xa2 Restricted/Constrained Endpoints \xe2\x80\xa2 Change WinRM Listener \xe2\x80\xa2 Change Windows Firewall settings \xe2\x80\xa2 Turn it off WinRM \xe2\x80\xa2 Application whitelisting 16. WINRM, NOT JUST AN INTERNAL ISSUE By default, Microsoft Azure virtual machines expose HTTPS listener to the Internet. 17.
